definitions.explanation: A wooden cabinet-style altar found in many Japanese homes, used for enshrining Buddhist objects, memorial tablets for deceased family members, and making daily offerings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{仏壇|ぶつだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: I pray at the Buddhist altar every morning.

examples.japanese: {仏壇|ぶつだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧とお⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}えた→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: I offered rice and tea at the Buddhist altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仏壇|ぶつだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read sutras in front of the Buddhist altar on my grandfather's death anniversary.
